chunks: 14 - Muhammad b. Ibrahim b. Ishaq narrated to us. He said: Abu al-Abbas Ahmad b. Ishaq al-Madiri (1) narrated to us in Basra in Rajab in the year 318 AH. He said: Abu Qilaba Abd al-Malik b. Muhammad narrated to us. He said: Ghanim b. al-Hasan al-Sadi narrated to us. He said: Muslim b. Khalid al-Makki narrated to us. He said: Jafar b. Muhammad narrated to us from his father (peace be upon them both), from Jabir b. Abdullah al-Ansari, from Ali b. Abi Talib (peace be upon him). He said:

He said: Fatima (peace be upon her) said to the Messenger of Allah (may Allah's blessings be upon him and his family): O my father! Where can I find you on the Day of the Great Stand, the Day of Horrors, and the Day of Great Dismay? He said: O Fatima! At the Gate of Paradise, and with me is the Banner of Praise, and I am the intercessor for my nation to my Lord. She said: O my father! What if I do not find you there? He said: Find me at the Pond, where I give water to my nation. She said: O my father! What if I do not find you there? He said: Find me on the Path, where I am standing, saying: My Lord! Safeguard my Nation. She said: What if I do not find you there? He said: Find me at the Scale, where I am saying: My Lord! Safeguard my Nation. She said: What if I do not find you there? He said: Find me at the mouth of Hell, where I prevent its sparks and its flames from my Nation.
So Fatima was gladdened by that — may the blessings of Allah be upon her, and upon her father, her husband, and her children (2).

key_terms.الحوض: The Pond — the heavenly pool of al-Kawthar from which the Prophet will give drink to his followers
key_terms.الشفاعة: Intercession — the Prophet's role as intercessor for his community before Allah
key_terms.الصراط: The Path — the bridge over Hell that all must cross on the Day of Judgment
key_terms.الميزان: The Scale — the divine balance where deeds are weighed on the Day of Judgment
key_terms.لواء الحمد: Banner of Praise — the banner the Prophet Muhammad (S) will carry on the Day of Judgment, symbolizing his exalted station

ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Muhammad tell Fatima about where to find him on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: Lady Fatima (SA) asks the Prophet (S) where she can find him on the Day of Judgment. He describes five stations: the Gate of Paradise with the Banner of Praise, the Pond, the Path, the Scale, and the edge of Hell — at each of which he intercedes for his nation.

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. Ibrahim b. Ishaq narrated to us. He said: Abu’l `Abbas Ahmad b. Ishaq al-Madiri narrated to us in Basra in Rajab in the year 318 AH. He said: Abu Qilaba `Abd al-Malik b. Muhammad narrated to us. He said: Ghanim b. al-Hasan al-Sa`di narrated to us. He said: Muslim b. Khalid al-Makki narrated to us. He said: Ja`far b. Muhammad narrated to us from his father (as) from Jabir b. `Abdullah al-Ansari from `Ali b. Abi Talib (as).

He said: Fatima (sa) said to the Messenger of Allah (s): O father! Where can I find you on the Day of the Great Stand, the Day of Horrors, and the Day of Great Dismay? He said: O Fatima! At the Gate of Paradise. I will have the Banner of Praise, and I am the intercessor for my Nation to my Lord. She said: O father! What if I do not find you there? He said: Find me at the Pond, where I will feed water to my Nation. She said: O father! What if I do not find you there? He said: Find me on the Path, where I will be standing and saying: “My Lord! Safeguard my Nation.” She said: What if I do not find you there? He said: Find me at the Scale, where I will be saying: “My Lord! Safeguard my Nation.” She said: What if I do not find you there? He said: Find me at the mouth of Hell, where I will be preventing its evil and its flames from my Nation.
So, Fatima was gladdened by that – may the blessings of Allah be upon her, and upon her father, her husband, and her children.
